newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV ENDS FIRMER AMID LOW LEV LIQUIDITY.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV ENDS FIRMER AMID LOW LEV LIQUIDITY.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev inched up to
1,569-1,571 per dollar at the close from the morning's
1,569-1573 on a dormant interbank market and amid low lev
"Current low lev liquidity resulted in higher foreign
currency supply while dollar demand remained low throughout the
day. Trade was thin and quiet," a commercial bank dealer said.
The lack of large payments on government securities this
week have impaired the lev liquidity of banks, dealers said.
Wage and tax payments by banks and companies due by
end-month have also increased the need for levs.
